parole.testo: Borrowed from Church Slavonic, from Proto-Slavic *zabordlo. Doublet of заборо́ло (zaborólo), the inherited East Slavic form.
Borrowed from Church Slavonic мѫжеложьство (mǫželožĭstvo). By surface analysis, муж (muž, “a man”) + -е- (-e-) + ложи́ть (ložítʹ, “to lay down”) + -ство (-stvo, “-ness”).

parole.significato: buggery, sodomy, male homosexuality or homosexual behaviour
